summary: Baozun Inc., a Cayman Islands issuer with weighted voting rights, filed a Form 6-K for August 2026. The filing attaches a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in authorized and issued share capital for July 2026. The report shows no changes in authorized share capital (500,000,000 shares total) or issued shares (174,284,503 including 13,162,277 treasury shares). It confirms compliance with public float requirements. This is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is purely administrative and informational.
